paper_title: Online Flow Time Minimization with Gradually Revealed Jobs
statement: In this paper, we introduce the operations flow time scheduling problem. We present an O(m2 )-competitive algorithm as well as a randomized lower bound of Ω(m). The more finegrained representation of our algorithms’ competitive ratio as O(m1 · m2 ) is asymptotically tight if either m1 = 1 or m2 = 1. It remains an open question whether an O(m)-competitive algorithm is possible. Furthermore, it would be interesting to see whether the large constants in the analysis can be improved, in particular for the special case with just two operations.
